segments.text: Queſt. 24th. How are theſe Articles divided?
Anſ. Into three Parts; the firſt is of God the Father, and our Creation; the ſecond of God the Son, and our Redemption; the third of God the Holy Ghoſt, and our Sanctification.

Queſt. 25th. Since there is only but one
Divine Eſſence, why ſpeakeſt thou of Father, Son, and Holy Ghoſt?
Anſ. Becauſe God hath ſo revealed himſelf in His Word, that theſe three diſtinct Perſons are the one only true and eternal God.
